Every morning, I open a book and look for a quiet place to read. The dog ran across the garden. The sky was bright, and the air felt cool. I read each sentence slowly and wrote my own translation. Some words were familiar, but others made me pause. A small dictionary helped me understand the story. I left a bookmark beside a sentence I wanted to remember. Later, I returned to the same page and read it again. Learning a language takes patience, attention, curiosity, practice, time, courage, care, effort, kindness, imagination, and joy. One sentence can open a new world. One word can change the way we see it. Tomorrow, I will come back and continue reading.
